etymologies.etymologyHTML: From French résistant; equivalent to resist +‎ -ant.

definitions.definition: A person who resists; especially a member of a resistance movement.
Which makes resistance or offers opposition.
Which is not affected or overcome by a disease, drug, chemical or atmospheric agent, extreme of temperature, etc.

quote.citation: 1975, Daniel McMahon, C. Fred Fox, Developmental Biology: Pattern Formation, Gene Regulation, Addison Wesley Longman:

definitions.definition: (statistics) Not greatly influenced by individual members of a sample.
